xna-type.name: GestureType
xna-type.summary: Contains values that represent different multitouch gestures that can be detected by TouchPanel.ReadGesture.
xna-type.remarks: These values can be combined when reading them from, or writing them to, TouchPanel.EnabledGestures .

member.name: Tap
member.summary: The user briefly touched a single point on the screen.

member.name: DoubleTap
member.summary: The user tapped the screen twice in quick succession. This always is preceded by a Tap gesture. If the time between taps is too great to be considered a DoubleTap, two Tap gestures will be generated instead.

member.name: Hold
member.summary: The user touched a single point on the screen for approximately one second. This is a single event, and not continuously generated while the user is holding the touchpoint.

member.name: HorizontalDrag
member.summary: The user touched the screen, and then performed a horizontal (left to right or right to left) gesture.

member.name: VerticalDrag
member.summary: The user touched the screen, and then performed a vertical (top to bottom or bottom to top) gesture.

member.name: FreeDrag
member.summary: The user touched the screen, and then performed a free-form drag gesture.

member.name: Pinch
member.summary: The user touched two points on the screen, and then converged or diverged them. Pinch behaves like a two-finger drag. When this gesture is enabled, it takes precedence over drag gestures while two fingers are down.

member.name: Flick
member.summary: The user performed a touch combined with a quick swipe of the screen. Flicks are positionless. The velocity of the flick can be retrieved by reading the Delta member of GestureSample.

member.name: DragComplete
member.summary: A drag gesture (VerticalDrag, HorizontalDrag, or FreeDrag) was completed. This signals only completion. No position or delta data is valid for this sample.

member.name: PinchComplete
member.summary: A pinch operation was completed. This signals only completion. No position or delta data is valid for this sample.
